data.headline: Founders Café plus cheap day passes

picks.name: AngelList Founders Café
picks.one_liner: Free, and cofounder-matching mixers built in
picks.insider: Apply for access before you land

picks.name: coworking sf (via LANS)
picks.one_liner: Cheapest real day pass, quiet phone booths

picks.name: Medium Café
picks.insider: Use as backup when Founders Café is busy

data.watch_out: Founders Café is invite-only; apply early.

data.headline: Lime pass, Muni backup

picks.name: Lime (monthly pass)
picks.one_liner: Cheapest fast way to cofounder meetups
picks.insider: Most spots reachable in ~20 minutes, no bus waits

picks.name: Muni bus / metro
picks.one_liner: Budget daytime rides between quiet cafés
picks.insider: Add Clipper to Apple/Google Wallet, skip cards

picks.name: Waymo
picks.one_liner: Safe late rides after evening events
picks.insider: Try once; feels safer than rideshare at night

data.watch_out: BART is for airports only, not inside SF.

data.headline: Mission, Valencia corridor, hacker house

picks.name: Hacker house in the Mission
picks.one_liner: Cheapest way to live with potential cofounders
picks.insider: Find openings via Luma/X posts and founder group chats

picks.name: Hayes Valley / Duboce
picks.one_liner: Calm cafés, short ride to SoMa events
picks.insider: Furnished sublets via Facebook groups, Furnished Finder

picks.name: Shared room in SoMa / South Park
picks.one_liner: Walk to most founder events nightly
picks.insider: Pick blocks carefully; empty and quiet at night

data.watch_out: Cheap 'Union Square' listings are often Tenderloin. Check map.

data.headline: Small rooms, hackathons, SPC events

picks.name: South Park Commons
picks.one_liner: Pre-idea people hunting cofounders gather here.
picks.insider: Events are high-signal; apply early on Luma.

picks.name: Entrepreneurs First (EF)
picks.one_liner: Hackathons reveal how potential cofounders actually build.
picks.insider: Go even if you won't win.

picks.name: AI Tinkerers
picks.one_liner: Small, quiet, technical rooms; demos over pitches.
picks.insider: Ask more than you pitch first weeks.

data.watch_out: Good Luma events fill fast; follow calendars now.
